en:
There are a lot of weird things around here.
Maybe we should investigate more?

I'm just really curious... I don't think
they'd be there for no reason.

You could really help me out, Kaede.
I'd like to hear from a different perspective.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time searching around the
school with Shuichi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi and I grew a little closer today.
